title: THURSDAY INTERVALS
subtitle: THURSDAY. INTERVALS. WORK THE CLOCK, NOT THE EGO. STEP-UP BALANCE, STAIR PUSH-UPS, SLOW MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. THEN OPEN THE CHEST AND THE SPINE. FEEL IT. DO NOT BE SORE TOMORROW.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. THURSDAY. INTERVALS. SIXTEEN MINUTES. THE CLOCK IS THE BOSS TODAY, NOT YOU. STEP UPS WITH A BALANCE HOLD, PUSH UPS ON THE FIFTH STAIR, SLOW MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. THEN WE OPEN THE CHEST AND THE SPINE. STEADY WORK. NOT A BLOODY SPRINT TRIAL.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. WORK WHEN IT SAYS WORK. REST WHEN IT SAYS REST. SIMPLE ENOUGH EVEN FOR AN ENGINEER.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. HANDS OFF THAT BLOODY PHONE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. HEART UP, CHEST OPEN, SPINE OILED, BALANCE OWNED. GO BACK TO YOUR DESK AND SIT UP STRAIGHT. IF I CATCH YOU HUNCHED LIKE A QUESTION MARK I WILL KNOW. I ALWAYS KNOW.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: STEP-UP TO BALANCE
exercises.cue: BOTTOM STAIR, HAND NEAR THE RAIL. STEP UP WITH ONE FOOT, DRIVE THROUGH THE WHOLE FOOT, AND LIFT THE OTHER KNEE TO HIP HEIGHT. HOLD THAT ONE-LEG BALANCE FOR A TWO-COUNT, CHEST TALL. STEP DOWN SLOW. ALTERNATE LEGS. STEADY PACE, NOT A RACE. TOUCH THE RAIL IF YOU WOBBLE.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS TO BALANCE. THREE ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. BOTTOM STAIR. STEP UP, KNEE UP, HOLD IT FOR TWO. THEN DOWN SLOW. SWAP LEGS. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. A HERON ON A RIVERBANK, NOT A DRUNK ON A KERB.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE LEGS OUT. EYES ON YOU.
exercises.speakDone: STEP UPS DONE. STEADY ON YOUR PINS. GOOD.

exercises.name: INCLINE PUSH-UP (5TH STAIR)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR, A BIT WIDER THAN SHOULDERS. WALK THE FEET BACK UNTIL YOU ARE ONE STRAIGHT PLANK FROM HEAD TO HEELS. LOWER THE CHEST TOWARD THE STEP, ELBOWS ABOUT 45 DEGREES, PRESS BACK UP. SMOOTH, STEADY REPS FOR THE WHOLE INTERVAL. PAUSE AT THE TOP IF YOU NEED IT. NO SAGGING HIPS.
exercises.speakStart: PUSH UPS. FIFTH STAIR. THREE ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. STRAIGHT LINE, HEAD TO HEELS. CHEST DOWN TO THE STEP, PRESS AWAY. SMOOTH REPS. IF THOSE HIPS SAG I WILL HANG MY WASHING ON THEM.
exercises.speakDone: PUSH UPS DONE. CHEST SAYS HELLO. GOOD.

exercises.name: SLOW STAIR MOUNTAIN CLIMBER
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR, SHOULDERS OVER HANDS, BODY IN A STRAIGHT INCLINE PLANK. DRIVE ONE KNEE TOWARD THE STEP, RETURN, THEN THE OTHER. SLOW AND CONTROLLED, ABOUT ONE KNEE PER SECOND. BELLY BRACED, HIPS LEVEL, NO BOUNCING. SLOW IT DOWN IF THE FORM GOES.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. HANDS ON THE FIFTH STAIR. THREE ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS. SLOW. ONE KNEE AT A TIME. BELLY TIGHT. HIPS LEVEL. THIS IS A MARCH, NOT A BLOODY DISCO.
exercises.speakRest: FORTY. STAND TALL. GET YOUR BREATH BACK.
exercises.speakDone: CLIMBERS DONE. HEART AWAKE. GOOD LAD.

exercises.name: WALL CHEST OPENER
exercises.cue: STAND SIDE-ON TO AN OPEN WALL. PLACE THE NEAR FOREARM FLAT ON THE WALL, ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT, BENT 90 DEGREES. STEP THE NEAR FOOT FORWARD AND GENTLY TURN THE CHEST AWAY FROM THE WALL UNTIL YOU FEEL THE FRONT OF THE SHOULDER AND CHEST OPEN. SHOULDER DOWN, RIBS DOWN. BREATHE SLOW. NO CRANKING.
exercises.speakStart: WALL CHEST OPENER. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. FOREARM ON THE WALL. ELBOW AT SHOULDER HEIGHT. TURN THE CHEST AWAY, NICE AND SLOW. THAT KEYBOARD HAS CURLED YOU UP LIKE A PRAWN. UNCURL.
exercises.speakDone: CHEST OPEN. SHOULDERS BACK WHERE THEY BELONG.

exercises.name: CAT-COW
exercises.cue: HANDS AND KNEES, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. INHALE: DROP THE BELLY, LIFT THE CHEST AND TAILBONE, EYES FORWARD (COW). EXHALE: ROUND THE SPINE TO THE CEILING, TUCK THE CHIN AND TAILBONE (CAT). MOVE WITH THE BREATH, ONE VERTEBRA AT A TIME. SLOW AND SMOOTH.
exercises.speakStart: CAT COW. TWO ROUNDS. SIX SLOW BREATHS. BREATHE IN, BELLY DOWN, CHEST UP. BREATHE OUT, ROUND THE BACK TO THE CEILING. MOVE WITH THE BREATH. YOUR SPINE IS A BICYCLE CHAIN THAT HAS BEEN LEFT OUT IN THE RAIN. OIL IT.
exercises.speakDone: CAT COW DONE. SPINE OILED. THAT IS THE LOT.
